text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the biggest race at the end of the year, gathering together the best of the classic and senior athletes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the paddock, Maruzensky is approached by an Umamusume who has, until now, avoided racing against her before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She is fascinated by Maruzensky's past performances and expresses her wish to run against her again someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky takes her words to heart and goes into the race with a strong desire to inspire others to continue racing.
